offering_description.value: Mines, processes and sells raw and dried frac sand (proppant) to oil and natural gas exploration and production companies and oilfield service companies. It operates mines and processing plants in Wisconsin and delivers sand by rail and through last-mile logistics and wellsite storage solutions. It also sells industrial sand for non-oilfield uses.

primary_services.value: last-mile sand logistics; wellsite sand storage systems; rail transloading

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production companies, pressure pumping and oilfield service companies, industrial sand buyers

end_markets.value: oil and natural gas exploration and production; industrial sand applications

revenue_model.value: product sales: frac sand sold under long-term take-or-pay contracts and spot sales; service fees: last-mile logistics and wellsite storage services

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: mines and processes sand from owned reserves, sold to oilfield service and E&P firms; service provider: last-mile delivery and wellsite storage for customers

geography_served.value: US national: Mines in Wisconsin, serves Permian, Eagle Ford, Marcellus/Utica, Bakken, Rockies and Mid-Continent basins, some Canadian exposure

specialization.value: related lines: frac sand production, industrial sand, and last-mile logistics and storage

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with E&P and oilfield service customers, delivered by unit-train rail and trucking

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining safety (MSHA), silica dust exposure (OSHA), and environmental and permitting rules

notes: Smart Sand's recent business mix and operations details are from memory and may be dated.
